title: Online Voting Using SingPass for Singaporeans based Overseas
what_it_is: Online Voting Using SingPass for Singaporeans based Overseas

sections.label: Internet voting feasibility study
sections.summary: The Elections Department studied Internet voting for overseas Singaporeans and found challenges including authentication, impersonation, secrecy, reliability, security and auditing, so paper ballot voting remains simplest and most transparent.

sentences.speaker: The Minister, Prime Minister's Office (Mr Chan Chun Sing) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: The Elections Department has studied the feasibility of Internet voting for overseas Singaporeans.

sentences.speaker: The Minister, Prime Minister's Office (Mr Chan Chun Sing) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: While Internet voting may appeal to some, it has various challenges, like difficulties in authenticating voters, preventing impersonation and ensuring voting secrecy.

sentences.speaker: The Minister, Prime Minister's Office (Mr Chan Chun Sing) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: In addition, there are system reliability issues and security risks, such as vulnerability to hacking and cyberattacks.

sentences.speaker: The Minister, Prime Minister's Office (Mr Chan Chun Sing) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: Auditing the voting results in the event of a petition to the Election Judge is also more challenging and potentially problematic.

sentences.speaker: The Minister, Prime Minister's Office (Mr Chan Chun Sing) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: The use of SingPass can only overcome the difficulties with authentication partially but not the other challenges with Internet voting.

sentences.speaker: The Minister, Prime Minister's Office (Mr Chan Chun Sing) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: For now, voting by paper ballot at polling stations is still the simplest and most transparent method of voting that can ensure the integrity and secrecy of our voting process.

sections.label: SingPass password and token risks
sections.summary: Someone obtaining a password or token means the method is not foolproof, and SingPass cannot entirely overcome these risks.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: If somebody is able to get his hands on the password or, for that matter, the token, then it is not a foolproof method.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: There are risks involved in all these, which SingPass itself, Page: 8 while it is an improvement over the past, will not be able to overcome entirely.
